exposure: Father's exposure to DMD at time of procreation
cohort: Pregnancies fathered by 78 male Multiple Sclerosis patients, with 45 fathers exposed to DMD at time of conception and 33 unexposed.
finding: No association was found between paternal disease-modifying drug (DMD) exposure at time of conception and risk of spontaneous abortion, adverse fetal outcomes, or congenital malformations.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in the frequency of cesarean delivery between pregnancies fathered by men with MS who were taking disease-modifying drugs at the time of conception and those who were not.
